title: Eighteen Years and One Low Step
subtitle: 残障与关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 残障与关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·关爱与帮扶）
meta: 主题语境：残障与关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·关爱与帮扶）　|　核心词汇：disability　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 disability 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the officer ① recorded a disability that no clerk in the office would have entered, and he said the recording was the whole of the claim. The ② disability, meaning the condition and not the allowance, ran eighteen years and stayed unremarked in the file; a disability, he said, is the only thing in a file that is judged by how long it is left unwritten.

Every ③ disability in that file had the same low step at the door of it, and the ④ disability at the end, meaning the one they kept for the winter cases and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever reviewed twice. A disability, his assistant said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the officer said the patience is the part that fills eighteen years.

The accountant meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the disability was the whole of the account, meaning the allowance and not the condition. The ⑥ disability, meaning the allowance and not any of that, is the only thing in an account that everybody totals and nobody questions; disability, she said, is either something you record or the only word that means both a condition and an allowance. She said the allowance is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ disability had become a line in a schedule, and the schedule had become an argument about the low step. The ⑧ disability of the whole thing, the officer wrote in March, was one file and eighteen years of recording; disability, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to record. She said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ disability I remember is the one at the end, which was reviewed in 1975 and is still described as the strangest in the file. A ⑩ disability, the assistant said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being understood; every disability, she said, is an allowance that has agreed to look like a condition. She said the allowance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 残疾；残障（指档案里记下的那一种）
B. n. 残障（指那种身体状况本身，与那笔津贴相对）
C. 固定搭配：record a disability 登记一种残障情况
D. n. 残障（指留给冬季个案的那一种）
E. n. 残障；障碍（抽象总称，指一份档案里的全部登记）
F. n. 残障（指明细表上写到、被列明的那一种）
G. n. 残障津贴；补助（指账户里合计的那笔钱）
H. n. 津贴（抽象总称，指人人合计却无人过问的那笔）

items.q: recorded a disability that no clerk in the office would have entered
The disability, meaning the condition and not the allowance
the disability was the whole of the account
the disability had become a line in a schedule
The disability of the whole thing
A disability, the assistant said in 1977

answers.why: record a disability 意为“登记一种残障情况”，1953 年官员登记了一种办公室里没有一位职员肯录入的残障情况。
disability 意为“残障”，指那种身体状况本身而不是那笔津贴，它在档案里搁了十八年而无人评说。
disability 意为“残疾、残障”，指那份档案里每一种残障，每一种门前都有同一级低台阶。
disability 意为“残障”，指留给冬季个案的那一种，是唯一有人复核过两次的。
disability 意为“残障津贴、补助”，指账户里合计的那笔钱，会计说这笔津贴就是那个账户的全部。
disability 意为“津贴”，指人人合计却无人过问的那笔而不是那种身体状况，是账户里人人都合计、却无人过问的东西。
disability 意为“残障”，指明细表上写到、被列明的那一种，到 1961 年这种残障成了明细表里的一行。
disability 意为“残障、障碍”，官员三月写道，整件事的登记是一份档案和十八年的记录。
disability 意为“残障”，我记得的是末尾那一种，1975 年被复核，至今仍被说成档案里最奇的一种。
disability 为抽象总称，助手 1977 年说，一种残障是唯一会因为被理解而变得更好的处境。
